capabilities: Manage daily events on a mini-calendar with a weekly view
Record daily metrics in a data log with monthly history and archiving
Track tasks in category boxes and check in habits with streaks
Capture timestamped daily moments and monthly plans with archive notes
Configure quick links that jump to chosen notes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no single daily page combining calendar events, metric tracking, tasks, habits, and planning, so users must piece together multiple plugins or notes.
summary: Dashboard plugin that gathers daily events, data logs, tasks, habit check-ins, timestamped moments, monthly plans, and quick links into one page.
